name: Ventas Suelto vs Combo
query:
select
  roi.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:150",
  roi.item_name as "Item Name:Data:180",
  sum(case when roi.combo_uid = '' or roi.combo_uid is null then roi.qty else 0 end) as "Sold Individually:Float:130",
  sum(case when roi.combo_uid != '' and roi.combo_uid is not null then roi.qty else 0 end) as "Sold In Combo:Float:120",
  sum(roi.qty) as "Total Qty:Float:100",
  sum(roi.amount) as "Total Revenue:Currency:140"
from `tabRestaurant Order Item` roi
inner join `tabRestaurant Order` ro on ro.name = roi.parent
where ro.docstatus = 1
  and (%(from_date)s is null or %(from_date)s = '' or ro.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  and (%(to_date)s is null or %(to_date)s = '' or ro.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
  and (%(company)s is null or %(company)s = '' or ro.company = %(company)s)
  and (%(item_code)s is null or %(item_code)s = '' or roi.item_code = %(item_code)s)
group by roi.item_code, roi.item_name
order by 5 desc
